reply_text:
I saved Pree's new cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork, 21 October from now on, in GBrain under her name. I also replied to her in the DM to confirm it.

The first save came out visible to everyone. Since she told me this privately, I saved it again as private and withdrew the public copy. Withdrawing a fact stops it from being used, but GBrain keeps a record of it. The memory search is running in a reduced mode, so it only catches exact duplicates. It found no earlier cutoff for her, but a differently worded old note wouldn't have shown up.
